verdict.rationale: The Cline overview says you can "build AI agents and integrations powered by the same core engine" behind the CLI, Kanban, VS Code and JetBrains products, which points to an official programmatic building surface (cline-docs-19). ACP also lets external clients embed Cline as their coding agent (cline-docs-26). However, the evidence never names an SDK package, supported languages, install steps or API reference, and the OpenAPI probe found nothing (cline-probe-3). Missing for 10: an explicitly named official SDK with language bindings, installation and API reference docs, usage examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against it.
